# Rachmad Syaefullah

> Senior frontend engineer based in Jakarta, specializing in React and Next.js, with 7+ years building fintech, banking and game infrastructure products end to end.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rachmad.id/): Intro, experience timeline, projects, skills, and contact links.

## Projects

- [Quickbill Platform](https://rachmad.id/projects/quickbill-platform): Invoicing and payments platform for businesses, built from the first commit across the Next.js app and the Go services.
- [Quickbill Enterprise](https://rachmad.id/projects/quickbill-enterprise): Quickbill for large companies, with maker-checker approval on every payment.
- [Quickbill Embedded Payment](https://rachmad.id/projects/quickbill-embedded-payment): An embeddable checkout that lets enterprise clients take Quickbill payments inside their own apps.
- [Quickbill UI](https://rachmad.id/projects/quickbill-ui): The design system and component library behind every Quickbill web app, shipped as an npm package.
- [Quickbill Mobile](https://rachmad.id/projects/quickbill-mobile): Quickbill's Flutter app, including its architecture and project structure.
- [1Engage Platform](https://rachmad.id/projects/1engage-platform): Multi-tenant platform for brands to run WhatsApp broadcasts, chatbots and voice at scale.
- [AccelByte Development Toolkit](https://rachmad.id/projects/accelbyte-dev-toolkit): Desktop app for getting game builds to playtesters and collecting crash reports.
- [AccelByte Multiplayer Servers (AMS)](https://rachmad.id/projects/accelbyte-multiplayer-service): AccelByte's dedicated game server hosting dashboard, including a real-time log monitor and Express BFF.
- [Moladin Refinancing](https://rachmad.id/projects/moladin-refinancing): Moladin's vehicle refinancing product: the customer application site and the internal sales CRM.
- [vOffice](https://rachmad.id/projects/voffice-website): vOffice Indonesia's main website and the Laravel CMS behind it.
- [IZIN.co.id](https://rachmad.id/projects/izin-co-id): Website for vOffice's legal and licensing service, with self-service tools for business owners.
- [Hellolive](https://rachmad.id/projects/hellolive): Website for vOffice's podcast studio and event space in Jakarta.
- [Shop&Bike](https://rachmad.id/projects/shop-and-bike): Company site with a small online shop for Astra Otoparts' motorcycle workshop chain.
- [Maybank Branch Delivery System](https://rachmad.id/projects/maybank-digital-branch): The system Maybank Indonesia branch staff use for counter transactions, including its move to micro-frontends.
